purpose: Retain current title-vector versions as FULL-fusion controls, so any gain is not automatically attributed to longer input
selection: finite weight on existing inner selection predictions; higher mean fold BA lower Brier smaller weight; no learned meta coefficients
existing_head_C: already selected in inner CV; not reselected using outer results
scope: same exposed 3-seed 10-fold partitions, all windows; no news exact FULL fallback
limitation: This is not a perfectly isolated input ablation: body-head C and weight are jointly selected, title head C was previously selected; body evidence gate also differs. Do not claim any observed difference uniquely measures semantic content.
